## Overview

This 2026-09-15 [[adyen|Adyen]] page is an iOS integration chooser for Scalapay. It routes readers to the method-specific iOS Drop-in and Components guides and to general iOS Sessions-flow integration guides. See [[adyen-online-payments]] and [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-scalapay|the Scalapay overview]] for captured method scope. This chooser does not specify request fields, supported countries, SDK versions, redirect-return behavior, current eligibility or payment outcomes.

## Key takeaways

- The page offers iOS Drop-in, described as an all-in-one UI solution, and iOS Components, described as a pre-built Component that renders Scalapay in the app. The linked method guides hold their respective setup details.
- For more information, it links general iOS Drop-in and Components Sessions-flow guides. These navigation links do not establish that either integration or a payment has been completed.
- This short page does not define Scalapay product variants, capture or refund behavior. Use the [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-scalapay|overview]] for the captured feature matrix and the linked iOS method guides for implementation details.
